One correctness issue in test setup:

- [updates/tests.rs:68](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.monthly-updates/exposed/src/lib/outbound/updates/tests.rs:68): `date_trunc('month', now())` uses PostgreSQL’s session timezone. In an east-of-UTC timezone, this inserts a registration before the UTC month, potentially leaving the expected company absent and failing the HTTP test. Bind the UTC `RegistrationMonth` start instead.

No production correctness, security, API, or data findings. Generic AppState propagation and ranking classification preserve existing behavior.

The new test UPDATE also lacks SQLx offline metadata, so offline builds including tests would fail; the current CI command excludes tests. No test suites run.
